newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia net foreign reserves hit record high.
newsitem.headline: Colombia net foreign reserves hit record high.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves stood at an all-time high of $10.167 billion as of May 16, the latest date for which official figures are available, the central bank reported Friday.

It said net reserves had expanded by $51.6 million between May 9-16, and by a total of $271.1 million from between January 1 and May 16. The bank expects Colombia's net reserves to rise by $750 million over the course of the year.
Most of the reserves, $9.301 billion, are invested in fixed-income instruments with foreign banks.
